Noto font glyph atlas uploads and `egui_wgpu::Renderer` triangle batching on the shared GPU device
geometry: 2D Clip-Space coordinates (`x, y in [-1, 1]`) and 2D screen-space UI widget rectangles (`egui::Rect`)
interaction: Command Dock (`src/command_dock/`): text input borrowing (`&mut String`), `VecDeque` history (200 entries), prefix auto-completion, Tab/Enter/Escape key routing, popup suggestion browsing, pointer capture, and wheel scroll consumption
First view command (`Background`) toggling clear color state between frames
runtime: WASM entry point (`#[wasm_bindgen(start)]`), async GPU initialization (`wasm_bindgen_futures::spawn_local`), uncaptured GPU error callbacks, and DOM status reporting
